ctx.x: And Felix Goff, he was on the clarinet and had another boy on the E flat clarinet called Stewart. I don't know what happened to him. He went out of the picture all at once, I don't know.

No, his name was Stewart. He had another name now, I just can't, but that was his first name, Stewart. Little short fella. And our drummers was a boy by the name of Jumerville, and another boy by the name of Dito, which Dito is dead now. Jumerville was the bass drummer and Dito was the snare drummer. And we just kept on with that little band like that so funny. We just worked ourselves up in two bands.
